items.statement: The investigation validates minima with no imaginary frequencies and transition states with one imaginary frequency plus a connectivity test, and retains candidate identity through energy assembly.
items.expected: Submitted candidate records show per-candidate frequency counts and an explicit mode/IRC or alternative connectivity validation for both OCM alternatives and the completed channels.

items.statement: Relative Gibbs energies consistently combine electronic, thermal and solvation contributions at the stated temperature and solvent standard states.
items.expected: The report states a reproducible energy assembly and identifies the reference state and units for every compared candidate.

items.statement: The cycloisomerization profile has an overall activation free energy of 22.8 kcal/mol from INT11.
items.expected: The submitted cycloisomerization activation free energy is consistent with 22.8 kcal/mol.

items.statement: The endo-OCM transition state is favored over exo-OCM by 7.5 kcal/mol.
items.expected: The submitted endo/exo transition-state difference is consistent with 7.5 kcal/mol and its sign is explained.

notes: The numerical references are private evaluator content.
